name: Sengoku no Mahou Shoujo Yuna ~Sono Haiboku, Soshite Shuuaku Naru Jutai e~
original_name: 戦獄の魔法少女・ユナ～その敗北、そして醜悪なる受胎へ～
source:
Happy schoolgirl Yuna met a strange creature collapsed by the road.
That encounter transformed Yuna into a magical girl with a mission to defeat Zomd, the Ultimate Enemy.

Now she, along with three recruited friends, faces a war without end, with the highest possible stakes. Will they strike down the legions of Zomd?
Or will they be sexually obliterated!?

Four heroines brave a battle they can't possibly win...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE119892.html]DLsite English[/url]]
